comments.author: Mrtko
comments.body_html:
The reviews I read tell that some parts heat up above 100 degrees which can lead to slowing down the current processes, and in the long term to faster wear and tear.

The overheating may happen not only due to running multiple apps simultaneously, but also due to hot weather outside.

So, as long as there are laptops with fans, I will prefer them

I think, one also could create their own site published on a free platform. Possible benefits include the following:

- It may serve as a personal knowledge base. 

- It could help others.

- You could share a link to reply to somebody's question (saves time).

- You can use it as part of your portfolio to demonstrate your expertise and grow your personal brand.
